bayts.text: O Giver of death (Al-Mumīt), restrain whoever has come at me with harm — (be there) for him (a punishment) swift —, O Afflicter (Aḍ-Ḍārr).
O Benefiter (An-Nāfiʿ), destroy whoever has aimed at my person with harm, and remove my toil.
O Generous (Al-Karīm), honour me with an honour that lasts, by the standing of him whose servant You have made me.
O One (Al-Aḥad), grant me never to associate (anything) with You, taking refuge (in You); disgrace for me whoever has associated.
You banished my doubt and my enemies on Thursday (al-khamīs), O You Who spared me the emir and the army (al-khamīs).
Teach me the sciences with the teaching of the All-Knowing, and grant me from You the speech of the Interlocutor (Moses).
My supplication You have answered, Lord, in Ṣafar: bury in the dust an enemy who has hated me.
O Loving (Al-Wadūd), love me without end, with security, joy and gifts.
O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), grant me the gifts of the Great, and lead my challenger at once to the graves.
Send down upon a person who has aimed at me with harm the onslaught of ʿAzrāʾīl (the angel of death): lead him to the sparks (of the Fire).
To the Chosen direct, without end, the best of Your two peaces, and increase my gifts.
My gifts, make them perpetually led to me, according to Your measure; spare me the fuel (of the Fire, Qurʾān 2:24).
To You I have turned, through the Prophet, (away) from the enemies: bless him, and avert the plotting of whoever has aggressed.
Grant me freedom from weapons through the Giver of death, and make me free of whoever has hated me and (soon) dies.
